items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Defranco was on the scene, playing all that stuff and they created a sound... right there in my band.

ctx.x: And then from there, now he already accumulating what he heard at 52nd, he developed something.
He started rising. He used to play behind the stage with a lead accordion. He used to write something and Buddy Defranco was on the scene, playing all that stuff and they created a sound.

Now, for the first time, he come in contact with the Cuban rhythm, right there in my band. He used to scratch his eye with his finger and listen. Oh, (unintelligible) what is that? And that's where he begin to get (inaudible). So then he had a conga player.
